article_title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The launch and scientific goals of Nasa's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
A repair mission to bring the Hubble telescope back to Earth
A plan to build a telescope on the surface of the Moon
The discovery of dark matter by the James Webb telescope
tasks.correct_answer: The launch and scientific goals of Nasa's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בשיגור טלסקופ רומן, במסעו לנקודת התצפית ובמחקרים שהוא צפוי לבצע.

tasks.prompt: How does Roman's field of vision compare with Hubble's and James Webb's?
options: It is four times smaller
It is about 100 times larger
It is exactly the same size
It can view only objects inside our solar system
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי נאס״א, שדה הראייה של רומן גדול פי 100 מזה של האבל ושל ג׳יימס וב.

tasks.prompt: Why will Roman operate about one million miles from Earth?
options: To communicate directly with astronauts on Mars
To avoid all gravitational forces
To reduce interference from infrared light coming from Earth and the Moon
To remain close enough for weekly repairs
tasks.correct_answer: To reduce interference from infrared light coming from Earth and the Moon
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המרחק עוזר למצלמות האינפרה־אדום להימנע מהפרעה של אור חום מכדור הארץ ומהירח.

tasks.prompt: Why is Roman's wide field of vision especially useful for its mission?
options: It eliminates the need for any scientific instruments
It lets the telescope land on newly discovered planets
It makes dark matter visible to the human eye
It allows large surveys and maps covering many galaxies and potential exoplanets
tasks.correct_answer: It allows large surveys and maps covering many galaxies and potential exoplanets
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שדה רחב מאפשר לסרוק אזורים עצומים, למפות מיליארדי גלקסיות ולאתר עולמות רבים ביעילות.

tasks.prompt: What does “vantage point” mean in the description of Roman's destination?
options: A location that provides a useful position for observation
A rocket engine used during launch
A protective cover for an infrared camera
A database containing the names of exoplanets
tasks.correct_answer: A location that provides a useful position for observation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: vantage point הוא מקום או עמדה שמעניקים תנאים טובים לתצפית.

tasks.prompt: What does “gravitational glue” suggest about dark matter?
options: It produces visible light around every galaxy
It pushes galaxies apart at increasing speed
Its gravity helps hold cosmic structures together
It is a material used to assemble telescopes
tasks.correct_answer: Its gravity helps hold cosmic structures together
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי המטפורי gravitational glue מתאר את כוח הכבידה של החומר האפל שמסייע להחזיק מבנים קוסמיים יחד.

tasks.prompt: Give five facts about Roman's launch, journey and expected operating life.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין חמש עובדות מדויקות על השיגור, ההיפרדות מהטיל, היעד, משך המסע או חיי המשימה.
expected_points: It launched on Sunday morning from Kennedy Space Center in Florida
It travelled on a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket
It separated from the rocket about 30 minutes after launch
It is making a journey of about 100 days
Its destination is roughly one million miles from Earth
It will orbit the Sun from that distant point
Its primary mission is planned for five years
Nasa hopes it can operate for 10 years

tasks.prompt: How will Roman complement rather than simply replace Hubble and James Webb?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין שדה הראייה, המיקום וסוג המחקר ולהסביר כיצד היכולות משלימות זו את זו.
expected_points: Roman's field of vision is about 100 times wider
Its broad surveys can map very large areas efficiently
James Webb also operates about one million miles away but has a narrower view
Hubble observes from only about 300 miles above Earth
Roman can identify large populations of galaxies and exoplanets
Other telescopes may provide more detailed observations of selected objects
Roman's panoramic maps add a different scale of evidence to existing observatories

tasks.prompt: Summarise Roman's capabilities, its principal scientific questions and the importance of its namesake.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את יכולת הסריקה, מחקר כוכבי הלכת והיקום, חומר ואנרגיה אפלים, וכן את תרומתה של ננסי גרייס רומן.
expected_points: Roman is a powerful next-generation space telescope
It has a field of vision 100 times larger than Hubble's and Webb's
It may discover tens of thousands or even 100,000 exoplanets
It will help assess whether distant worlds could be habitable
It will map billions of galaxies
It will investigate dark matter and dark energy
Together dark matter and dark energy are thought to make up about 95% of the Universe
It is named for Nasa's first chief astronomer and first female executive
Nancy Grace Roman helped secure approval for Hubble

tasks.prompt: Write a short explanation for a general audience of why Roman may change our understanding of the Universe. Use at least three facts from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית ברורה, להסביר את חשיבות המשימה ולהשתמש לפחות בשלוש עובדות קונקרטיות.
expected_points: Explain the advantage of a field of vision 100 times larger than earlier telescopes
Mention the expected discovery of many exoplanets
Connect exoplanet research to the question of habitability or life
Describe the planned maps of billions of galaxies
Explain that dark matter and dark energy are known through their effects
Mention Roman's distant observing position
